name: Jorquel
description: Jorquel hangs along the inner arm, a compact court of worlds bound to a brown-dwarf heart. Resonant chains lock the middle planets into a slow stately dance visible over decades. A standing bounty covers any intact core sample from the second planet outward.

stars.name: Veiled Lantern
stars.description: A brown-dwarf of 0.04704 solar masses, planet-like atmosphere against the dark. A failed star glowing dull magenta, more ember than sun. Its light curve is a calibration standard for the whole sector.

asteroids.name: Granite 923
asteroids.description: A tumbling rock with a scarred face and a patient spin. Its regolith hides metal concentrations the assays prize. Outgassing cracks suggest ice beneath the dust mantle.

belts.name: Umber Belt
belts.description: Countless fragments grind slowly against each other in a broad torus. Collisional dust hazes the lane, and larger bodies keep eccentric courts. Old mining claims dot the denser knots, most of them long expired.
